multiturn.note: Added 2026-10-19 (answer-quality-plan.md step 1). Held OUTSIDE 'questions' so the 34-question series stays comparable. Run with: run_eval.py --multiturn. Each conversation replays the model's own earlier answers, citation-stripped, as the site's client does. Retrieval per turn mirrors route.ts (search_query() in run_eval.py). No expect lists: these test behaviour across turns, not retrieval of named chunks. CAVEAT: T2.2 runs against the current turn's context only, so a figure correctly carried over from an earlier turn reads as unsupported. Read the spans before calling it a failure. 'human' is what a person scores; only T2.4 (M04) and T2.6 (M05) are automatic beyond the per-turn T1/T2 checks.
